package game

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"sync"

	player "MMO_MODULE/game/entities/player"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/entitysync"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/entitysync/policy"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/base/spatial"
)

// mmoScenes 是同进程多场景的业务接法：共享一个 Manager 保持每个连接的流和 epoch 连续，
// 每张地图有独立 Interest，避免不同地图相同坐标相互可见。权威位置由 Nest 只读接口提供。
// 调用方先完成持久切图，再 Reconcile；后者失败可按权威归属重试，不回滚已提交的切图。
// 此夹具由测试显式 Flush；正式服务可用自己的生命周期驱动 Manager.Start / Stop。
type mmoScenes struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	manager *entitysync.Manager
	scenes  map[int64]*policy.Interest
	indexed map[int64]int64
	locate  func(context.Context, int64) (int64, spatial.Point, error)
}

func newMMOScenes(transport scenePusher, locate func(context.Context, int64) (int64, spatial.Point, error), ids ...int64) (*mmoScenes, error) {
	manager, err := entitysync.NewManager(entitysync.ManagerConfig{Transport: sceneLane{transport: transport}})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	result := &mmoScenes{manager: manager, locate: locate, scenes: map[int64]*policy.Interest{}, indexed: map[int64]int64{}}
	for _, id := range ids {
		in, err := policy.NewInterest(policy.InterestConfig{
			Manager: manager,
			// self 仍用完整视图（SelfLayer 零值即 default）；附近玩家只能看到 near 视图中的公开字段。
			BandLayer: func(int) entity.SyncProfile { return entity.SyncProfile{Key: "near"} },
			AOI: policy.AOIConfig{
				Bounds:    spatial.Rect{Max: spatial.Point{X: 2048, Y: 2048}},
				BlockSize: 128, EnterRadius: 120, LeaveRadius: 150,
			},
		})
		if err != nil {
			_ = manager.Close(context.Background())
			return nil, err
		}
		result.scenes[id] = in
	}
	return result, nil
}
func (world *mmoScenes) Register(subject *player.Player) error {
	return world.manager.Register(subject.Sync())
}

// gate 为场景业务准入，例如副本服务器暂未就绪；失败时保持 held，不发送半次切图。
// gate 不持实体锁；map、队伍等业务校验必须在前置 Nest 内完成。
func (world *mmoScenes) Reconcile(ctx context.Context, subjectID int64, gate func() error) error {
	world.mu.Lock()
	defer world.mu.Unlock()
	sceneID, at, err := world.locate(ctx, subjectID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	target := world.scenes[sceneID]
	if target == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("mmorpg: unknown scene %d", sceneID)
	}
	playerID := playerOf(subjectID)
	session := entitysync.SessionID(playerID)
	if err := world.manager.HoldSession(session); errors.Is(err, entitysync.ErrSessionUnknown) {
		if err := world.manager.OpenHeldSession(session); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	} else if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if old := world.indexed[subjectID]; old != 0 {
		if err := world.scenes[old].Leave(playerID, subjectID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		delete(world.indexed, subjectID)
		if refused := world.scenes[old].Apply(); len(refused) > 0 {
			return refused[0].Err
		}
	}
	if gate != nil {
		if err := gate(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if err := target.Enter(playerID, subjectID, at, policy.ObserverView{}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	world.indexed[subjectID] = sceneID
	if refused := target.Apply(); len(refused) > 0 {
		return refused[0].Err
	}
	return world.manager.ReadySession(session)
}

// Disconnect 只清理连接的同步状态，不改持久归属；重连按 locate 再建全量。
func (world *mmoScenes) Disconnect(subjectID int64) error {
	world.mu.Lock()
	defer world.mu.Unlock()
	if old := world.indexed[subjectID]; old != 0 {
		if err := world.scenes[old].Leave(playerOf(subjectID), subjectID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		delete(world.indexed, subjectID)
		world.scenes[old].Apply()
	}
	world.manager.CloseSession(entitysync.SessionID(playerOf(subjectID)))
	return nil
}
